description.narrative: This activity Implementation of the Tackling Maternal and Child Undernutrition Programme - Pilot Phase is a component of Tackling Maternal and Child Undernutrition Programme- Phase II reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £10,760,367. It works in the following sector(s): Basic nutrition, Social Protection, Agricultural policy and administrative management.
